entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your creator was a soldier and person of war, and your memories are filled with the taste of blood.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 5th, shabti.

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can cast greater magic weapon as a spell-like ability. You gain a second daily use at 9th level, and a third at 15th level. Only you can benefit from this spell-like ability; anyone else who wields the enchanted weapon gains no benefit from the spell. The caster level for this ability is equal to your character level.
